title: Qwen Ultra context validation and clearer controls
items: Venture now offers Maximum verified context for Qwen Ultra, dynamically matching the highest context that passed real FUPCJ tests.
Run Qwen-Ultra.ps1 -Action Tune -MaxContext on the Windows processor during a quiet period, with OBS and Streamlabs fully closed. The existing working context is retained if a larger test fails.
The output-token description now shows the actual verified context size rather than an internal setting name.
The response slider reserves visible answer space per pass when long responses are enabled; larger context alone does not guarantee greater accuracy.
Existing conversations, files, model weights and other Vision/Vortex features are preserved.
